sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong leaders and will be heavy favourites against a struggling Alsager side who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. The title race could intensify with AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, entertaining Eccleshall at home—Eccleshall sit fifth but have won their last outing, making this a notable test. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in-form with recent wins, travel to face Wednesfield Community (away to Wolverhampton Casuals on Saturday, then hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday). Bilston Town continue their own strong run at home to Foley Meir on Saturday. Mid-table action includes Barnton welcoming Shawbury United—Shawbury on a concerning five-game losing streak—while Cheadle Heath Nomads face an away trip to Telford Town, and Market Drayton Town host New Mills in what could be a tight mid-table clash. Brereton Social, inconsistent this season, start at home to Widnes Town on Saturday before the midweek trip to Wednesfield; Widnes remain pointless at the bottom. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-table fixture with both teams seeking to climb away from the danger zone.
